description: Active listings/auctions for a market. Each row carries the ask and the position's underlying contents priced at current market (published formula: /docs#data-sources), plus discountPct (the difference between them). Sorted by discount percentage, descending.

minDiscountPct.description: only return orders at >= this discount %. IGNORED on markets whose asset has no priced underlying, where there is nothing to compare the ask against — the response says so in `note` rather than returning an empty market.

nameContains.description: case-insensitive substring match on the listing's label (the name on name markets, e.g. 'alice'; 'veAERO #123' elsewhere)

name: get_listings
